name: flowaudit
description: Local web security scanning with Playwright, ZAP, a screen-flow evidence graph and complete ASVS 5.0.0 L1 assessments.

interface.shortDescription: Scan web apps and inspect evidence by screen.
interface.longDescription: Explore authorized web applications, review ZAP findings and ASVS L1 evidence, and export a local interactive report.
defaultPrompt: Scan my configured flowaudit project and export the evidence report.
Review the ASVS L1 evidence for my latest security scan.
